title: Nampa Train Depot Museum and Interpretive Center

services.name: Guided tour
services.desc: At the Canyon County Historical Society, we believe history comes alive when students experience it firsthand. Our field trips invite students to step into the stories of Canyon County through engaging exhibits, hands-on learning opportunities, knowledgeable volunteer docents, and our Canyon County Historical Society mascot team. Our signature field trip experience includes both of our museums in one day, giving students a broader understanding of Canyon County's rich history. blurb: The Nampa Train Depot celebrates over 120 years of service to the Nampa community. Known for its architectural elegance, it is believed to be the only depot of its kind in the United States.
